{{Quote|The next day they loaded our Zs on a Venator headed back to Ividal.|Jorn Kulish|<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-10-the-rise-of-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 10: The Rise of the Empire}}</ref>}}
'''Ividal''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located in the [[Ividal system/Legends|Ividal system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Foxfire Squadron]], a [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] of the [[Ividal Sector Forces]] equipped with [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], was stationed at Ividal.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

At some point during that conflict, the [[Republic Military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] recruited the Foxfire Squadron for a [[Bomber/Legends|bombing]] [[Attack on Ongary IX|attack]] on [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] starfighter bases on [[Ongary IX]]. On the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] that followed the Republic's destruction of one of the Separatist bases, the Foxfire Squadron's starfighters were loaded aboard a Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] bound to return to Ividal. One of the Foxfire Squadron [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], [[Jorn Kulish]], however, had decided to leave the service after the experience of the Ongary IX attack and instead left on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]]-bound [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ividal was originally intended to be introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the celestial body was cut before the book's release.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The information regarding Ividal was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ividal [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the astronomical object Ividal, in grid square P-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
